subclauses.title: This standard (Part 1) specifies the safety and interchangeability requirements, together with the test
subclauses.content:
1.1 This standard (Part 1) specifies the safety and interchangeability requirements, together with the test
methods and conditions required to show compliance of tubular and non-tubular self-ballasted LED lamps for
general lighting services.

subclauses.title: It applies to self-ballasted LED lamps having:

requirements.subject: self-ballasted LED lamp

conditions.intended_use: domestic and similar general lighting services

acceptance_criterion.criterion_text: Applies to self-ballasted LED lamps having rated wattage up to 60 W

requirements.evidence: This standard specifies safety for LED lamps having a rated wattage up to 60 W.

provenance.section: It applies to self-ballasted LED lamps having:

clauses.title: NORMATIVE REFERENCES
clauses.content:
2 NORMATIVE REFERENCES
The following standards contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this
standard:
- IS 15885 (Part 2/Sec 13) : 2012 Safety of lamp controlgear: Part 2-13 Particular requirements for d.c. or a.c.
supplied electronic controlgear for LED modules
- IS/IEC 60061 Lamp caps and holders together with gauges for the control of interchangeability and safety
- IS/IEC 60529 Degrees of protection provided by enclosures (IP Code)

subclauses.title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamp ? A unit which cannot be dismantled without being permanently damaged,
subclauses.content:
3.1 Self-Ballasted LED Lamp ? A unit which cannot be dismantled without being permanently damaged,
provided with a lamp cap and incorporating a light-emitting diode (LED) light source and any additional
elements necessary for stable operation of the light source.

subclauses.title: Rated Voltage ? The voltage or voltage range marked on the lamp.
subclauses.content: 3.2 Rated Voltage ? The voltage or voltage range marked on the lamp.

subclauses.title: Rated Wattage ? The wattage marked on the lamp.
subclauses.content:
3.3 Rated Wattage ? The wattage marked on the lamp.
IS 16102 (Part 1) : 2026 (Page 2)

subclauses.title: Self-ballasted LED lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal use they function reliably and
subclauses.content:
4.1 Self-ballasted LED lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal use they function reliably and
cause no danger to persons or surroundings.

requirements.subject: self-ballasted LED lamp
requirements.original_value: Mark of origin, rated voltage, rated wattage, rated frequency, standard mark
requirements.value: Trade mark, rated voltage, rated wattage, rated frequency, standard mark

conditions.durability_test: Rubbing 15 s with hexane soaked cloth

acceptance_criterion.criterion_text: Marking shall remain legible and easily discernible

requirements.evidence: Lamps shall be clearly and durably marked with mandatory details.

subclauses.title: Interchangeability shall be ensured by the use of caps complying with IS/IEC 60061.
subclauses.content: 6.1 Interchangeability shall be ensured by the use of caps complying with IS/IEC 60061.

subclauses.title: Bending moment of the cap fitment shall withstand standard mechanical torque without loosening or
subclauses.content:
6.2 Bending moment of the cap fitment shall withstand standard mechanical torque without loosening or
breakage.

subclauses.title: The lamp shall be so constructed that, without any additional enclosure in the form of a luminaire, no live
subclauses.content:
7.1 The lamp shall be so constructed that, without any additional enclosure in the form of a luminaire, no live
parts are accessible when the lamp is installed in a lampholder.

clauses.content: 8 INSULATION RESISTANCE AND ELECTRIC STRENGTH AFTER HUMIDITY TREATMENT

subclauses.title: Insulation resistance between current-carrying metal parts and accessible parts shall be not less than 4 M?.
subclauses.content: 8.1 Insulation resistance between current-carrying metal parts and accessible parts shall be not less than 4 M?.

test.test_points: between live parts and accessible conductive parts

acceptance_criterion.criterion_text: The insulation resistance shall be not less than 4 MΩ

requirements.evidence: Insulation resistance shall be not less than 4 MΩ between live parts and accessible parts.

provenance.original_text: 8.1 Insulation resistance between current-carrying metal parts and accessible parts shall be not less than 4 M?.

subclauses.title: Electric strength test: A voltage of 4 000 V a.c. (r.m.s.) shall be applied for 1 minute between
subclauses.content:
8.2 Electric strength test: A voltage of 4 000 V a.c. (r.m.s.) shall be applied for 1 minute between
current-carrying parts and accessible parts. No flashover or breakdown shall occur.

subclauses.title: Cap torque resistance: The cap shall remain firmly attached to the lamp when subjected to a torque of 3.0
subclauses.content:
9.1 Cap torque resistance: The cap shall remain firmly attached to the lamp when subjected to a torque of 3.0
Nm for B22d caps and 2.0 Nm for E27 caps.

subclauses.title: External parts of insulating material providing protection against electric shock shall be resistant to heat
subclauses.content:
10.1 External parts of insulating material providing protection against electric shock shall be resistant to heat
and fire.

subclauses.title: Glow-wire test: When tested in accordance with IS 11000 (Part 2/Sec 1), the test temperature shall be 650
subclauses.content:
10.2 Glow-wire test: When tested in accordance with IS 11000 (Part 2/Sec 1), the test temperature shall be 650
°C for parts not holding live parts and 750 °C for parts holding live parts in position.

conditions.specimen_support: tissue paper spread 200 ± 5 mm below specimen

acceptance_criterion.criterion_text: Any flames or glowing must extinguish within 30 s after withdrawal of glow-wire

requirements.evidence: Glow-wire test at 650°C / 750°C according to IS 11000 (Part 2/Sec 1).

provenance.original_text:
10.2 Glow-wire test: When tested in accordance with IS 11000 (Part 2/Sec 1), the test temperature shall be 650
°C for parts not holding live parts and 750 °C for parts holding live parts in position.

subclauses.title: The lamp shall not impair safety under condition of component failure (driver short circuit, capacitor failure,
subclauses.content:
11.1 The lamp shall not impair safety under condition of component failure (driver short circuit, capacitor failure,
or LED module breakdown).
